experiment: In-Test Molecular Networking with Hard Rank-1 Shield

mathematical_formulation.regime_a_shield: c_1 is frozen (w_top = 0.00). Ranks 2..25 reordered via S(c_i) = z(-ln(i)) + lambda * z(N(c_i)).
mathematical_formulation.regime_b_c: S(c_i) = z(-ln(i)) + lambda * z(N(c_i)) with anchor-weighting from neighbor Regime A hits.
mathematical_formulation.support_kernel: N(c_i) = sum_{b in N(m)} w(m, b)^4 * sum_{j=1}^{K_nb} (1/j) * Tanimoto(FP(c_i), FP(c_j^(b)))
